title: Suggestions register with decision paths and review status

rows.suggestion: Add a price-snapshot store that records opening and closing numbers for every market we originate
rows.rationale: Without prices we cannot compute closing line value, which is the cleanest available evidence that a signal is skill and not luck.
rows.risk: Medium: introduces a dependency on an external feed
rows.path_a: A: Pipe in the owner's own sportsbook account export on a schedule.
rows.path_b: B: Buy a licensed odds API.
rows.path_c: C: Stay paper-only and score strategies against our own originated lines with no market comparison.

rows.suggestion: Add a verified results feed so backtests and ROI can be computed at all
rows.rationale: Every validation gate that involves outcomes is currently uncomputable.
rows.path_a: A: Probe further official endpoints for a server-rendered results table.
rows.path_b: B: Use official per-team season standings as a coarse results proxy (verifiable but low resolution).

rows.suggestion: Make the verifier a required check in the refresh job and fail the job loudly on a regression
rows.rationale: Right now a bad pull is detected but does not stop anything.
rows.path_a: A: Fail the job when a dataset's verified row count drops by more than a set percentage.
rows.path_b: B: Keep it advisory and publish the count on the site only.
rows.path_c: C: Fail on any unverified row at all.

rows.suggestion: Originate the side first, then the total, then the moneyline
rows.rationale: The officially verifiable inputs we already have (scoring, passing, rushing, standings) support a side and total model today; the moneyline needs a win-probability model.
rows.path_a: A: Side only for the first cycle.
rows.path_b: B: Side and total together.

rows.suggestion: Publish the model's fair line, the market line, and the difference as separate columns
rows.rationale: A reviewer needs to see the edge, not just a pick; it also makes the CLV gate auditable.
rows.path_a: A: Show our line, market line and edge in one table.
rows.path_b: B: Show only our line.

rows.suggestion: Separate 'signal' from 'staking' in the leaderboard so a lucky staking run cannot mask a bad signal
rows.rationale: The brief asks to remove luck; the cleanest split is to score signal quality (CLV, hit rate vs price) separately from realised ROI.
rows.risk: Medium: two leaderboards instead of one
rows.path_a: A: Two leaderboards: signal score and realised ROI.
rows.path_b: B: One blended score.

rows.suggestion: Cap the number of live strategies and require a pre-registration record before a strategy can bet
rows.rationale: Pre-registration is the standard cure for selecting a strategy after seeing the results.
rows.path_a: A: Pre-register hypothesis, inputs and gates in the repo before any bet is graded.
rows.path_b: B: Allow post-hoc strategies.
rows.path_c: C: Cap at a fixed number with no pre-registration.

rows._source_label: NFL.com — Official NFL Injury Report (source of the deficiency inputs)
rows.suggestion: Flag a slot as uncovered when a club prints fewer than two names at that position
rows.rationale: A single printed name means there is no verified replacement, so the deficiency model must say so rather than guess.
rows.path_a: A: Require two printed names to call a slot covered.
rows.path_b: B: Treat a single name as covered with an unknown backup.

rows._source_label: NFL.com — Official NFL Injury Report (source of the deficiency inputs)
rows.suggestion: Track the depth of the replacement, not just the fact of a replacement
rows.rationale: The brief specifically calls out 2nd, 3rd and 4th string; the severity of a loss is a function of how far down the chart the club has to go.
rows.path_a: A: Record the exact string number of the next available player (already implemented).
rows.path_b: B: Only record starter out / starter in.
rows.path_c: C: Record a club-level injury count.

rows.suggestion: Keep every pull in git so no history is lost
rows.rationale: Correlations and CLV need history, and git gives it for free with a full audit trail.
rows.path_a: A: Commit every refresh (already implemented).
rows.path_b: B: Keep only the latest snapshot.
rows.path_c: C: Store snapshots in an external bucket.

rows.suggestion: Add a per-dataset verification bar showing verified vs flagged row counts on every table
rows.rationale: Makes the verification rule visible instead of implied.
rows.path_a: A: Show counts above every table (already implemented).
rows.path_b: B: Show counts on one summary page only.

rows.suggestion: Add a filter for 'flagged rows only' on every table
rows.rationale: The owner asked to review flagged items; a filter is faster than a separate page per dataset.
rows.path_a: A: Checkbox on every table (already implemented).
rows.path_b: B: Flagged page only.

rows._source_label: NFL.com — Official NFL Injury Report (source of the deficiency inputs)
rows.suggestion: Retry failing club depth charts with a longer backoff and record the attempt log publicly
rows.rationale: Several official club sites failed transiently; a public attempt log turns a silent gap into a reviewable item.
rows.path_a: A: Longer backoff, multiple path candidates, publish attempts (already implemented).
rows.path_b: B: Retry silently.

rows.suggestion: Compute correlations only from officially sourced numbers and publish n with each value
rows.rationale: A correlation from 32 team-seasons is a weak estimate; publishing n makes that honest.
rows.path_a: A: Publish r, n and p alongside every pair (already implemented).
rows.path_b: B: Publish r only.
rows.path_c: C: Publish a qualitative strength label.

rows.suggestion: Do not price player-prop correlations until a player-level official source exists
rows.rationale: No official source for prop-level data was verified; filling the gap by hand would be fabrication.
rows.path_a: A: Leave prop correlation blank and flagged until sourced.
rows.path_b: B: Use team-level correlation as a proxy.

rows.suggestion: Record a decision and a named owner for every suggestion before implementation
rows.rationale: The brief requires a review step and a chosen path before changes are made.
rows.path_a: A: decision_status + owner columns in the suggestions table (already implemented).
rows.path_b: B: Track decisions in issues only.

rows.suggestion: Alert when a scheduled refresh produces zero rows for a dataset that previously had rows
rows.rationale: Silent staleness is the main operational risk of an unattended pipeline.
rows.path_a: A: Add a job-level failure on empty pulls.
rows.path_b: B: Publish the count only.

rows.suggestion: Pin the refresh schedule to the league's own reporting cadence
rows.rationale: Injury reports are updated through the week; sampling every 6 hours matches that cadence without hammering the source.
rows.path_a: A: Every 6 hours with an extra game-day pass (already implemented).
rows.path_b: B: Hourly.

rows.suggestion: Version every originated line and keep the history
rows.rationale: CLV attribution and post-mortems are impossible without knowing what the line was when it was published.
rows.path_a: A: Append a timestamped line history file on each refresh.
rows.path_b: B: Keep only the current line.

rows.suggestion: Define a demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper
rows.rationale: Paper validation does not guarantee live performance; a demotion path protects the bankroll.
rows.path_a: A: Demote on a drawdown or CLV threshold (needs Q-26).
rows.path_b: B: Manual demotion only.

note: Each suggestion lists three paths and a recommended one. Nothing here is implemented until decision_status is set to Approved by the owner.
